verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform that could plausibly offer natural-language operation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only SDKs, APIs, a Postman collection, a dashboard and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, docs.md). These are developer building blocks or documentation aids, not a first-party way to operate the product through natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
